name: search_vault
description: Search notes across the Obsidian Work Vault by keyword or phrase. Returns matching note names, relative paths and relevant snippet lines.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for.

folder.description: Optional folder prefix to narrow search (e.g. '04 - Servidores', '10 - Procedimentos').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10).
